Art & asset credits

Existing artist-made models and scanned materials are bundled locally. No AI-generated graphics are used.

  • Ultimate Modular Men — Quaternius. Farmer and Adventurer meshes, rigs, and authored animations. CC0. The Adventurer comes from the artist's Poly Pizza listing. The Farmer comes from the credited public mirror, with Idle, Walk, and Run clips retained. Costume colors are adjusted and the Adventurer backpack is hidden.
  • Textured Stylized Trees — Quaternius. Tree 1, Tree 4, Birch 3, Pine 2 and original bark and leaf textures. CC0.
  • Nature Kit — Kenney. Imported shrubs, grass clumps, reeds, and distant rock formations. CC0.
  • Fern 02 — Poly Haven, Rico Cilliers and Rob Tuytel. Scanned fern mesh and texture maps. CC0.
  • Boulder 01 — Poly Haven. Scanned rock geometry and original textures. A reduced-detail derivative mesh is used for performance. CC0.
  • Forest Ground 04 — Poly Haven. Scanned soil color and roughness maps. CC0.
  • KayKit Adventurers — Kay Lousberg. One-handed sword and original texture. CC0.
  • Concrete Wall 006, Wood Planks Grey, and Aerial Grass Rock — Poly Haven. Scanned wall, timber, and grass material maps. CC0.

CC0 1.0 license · Three.js MIT license

The setting is fictional. These general-purpose character assets are not historical reconstructions of Chinese clothing. Existing village buildings and layout remain from the first prototype.
